text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Nhaha! Trai-poyo, your face looks 
completely dead! Don't get so bummed out 
over just this~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It feels a tiny bit weird, but seriously, 
that's all! I can totally manage something 
like this~☆
choice_data_list:
I'd like you to rest quietly until you're 
healed...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
!!!! Sowwy sowwy! Don't be so bummed 
out~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to understand my genuine 
concern, and I was able to get her to rest 
quietly...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy, sounds Gucci! I mean, I'm kinda 
bummed? So let's turn up the vibes to make 
up for it♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she kept on laughing cheerfully, 
Daitaku Helios's injury had ended up 
worsening...
